name: Google libphonenumber (PhoneNumberMetadata.xml)
note: The closest licence match any source in this corpus has: Apache-2.0 into an Apache-2.0
project, so there is nothing to reconcile.
Only the metadata file is taken, not the library. Decoy needs the *shapes* -- how a
country writes its numbers -- and those are a capture pattern and a template sitting in
the XML, from which a mask falls out directly. Pulling in the formatting engine to
produce example numbers and then reducing them back to masks would be the long way
round to the same answer, with a runtime dependency at the end of it.
Pinned to a release tag rather than master: the metadata changes whenever a country
renumbers, which is often, and a branch pin would silently alter every phone number
